name: component-change
description: Streamlined pipeline for modifying an existing component (skips initial design phase)
trigger: Parameter change, tolerance adjustment, or bug fix on existing component

phases.name: Update Parameters
phases.description: Modify component.json and shared/parameters.json if needed

phases.name: Update Drawings
phases.description: Regenerate affected views with new dimensions

phases.name: Update FreeCAD Script
phases.description: Modify script to reflect parameter changes, re-export STL

phases.name: BOM Check
phases.description: Verify BOM still correct (quantities, materials unchanged?)

phases.name: Build Guide Check
phases.description: Update guide if assembly steps changed
